Title: Azure AD Domain Services is available in new regions

Body.Content:
Azure Active Directory Domain Services is available in 10 new Azure regions:

  • West Central US
  • North Central US
  • Canada East
  • Canada Central
  • Brazil South
  • Central India
  • West India
  • South India
  • Japan East
  • Japan West

For a full list of Azure regions in which the service is available, see Products available by region.
